column1: # VGP multi-tool repeat track -- tool manifest
# One row per annotation tool. This file is the authority for which tools exist,
# what they are capable of detecting, and how they are rendered.
# COLUMNS
#   tool_id        Short stable key. Used in the bitmask, in the `methods` field
#                  of the summary track, and in output filenames. Do not rename
#                  after a hub is published -- it is user-visible.
#                  ROW ORDER IS THE BITMASK ORDER. Each tool's bit is its row
#                  index, so APPEND new tools at the END of the table. Inserting
#                  mid-table renumbers every tool below it, and any mask stored
#                  in an already-built track then decodes to the wrong tools.
#   short_label    Display name in the browser track list (UCSC caps ~17 chars).
#   long_label     Full description for trackDb longLabel.
#   version        Tool version used for this run. Propagates into track docs.
#   scope          THE SUPPORT DENOMINATOR. Which loci this tool is capable of
#                  calling at all. A tool is only counted in `nEligible` for a
#                  locus whose consensus class is within its scope.
#                    general_homology : any repeat, library-based (RepeatMasker-like)
#                    ltr_only         : LTR retrotransposons only
#                    structural_te    : structural/de-novo TE detection, TE classes only
#                    tandem           : satellites / simple repeats / low complexity
#   rm_fields      yes|no -- does this tool populate the RepeatMasker-specific
#                  columns (SW score, perc_div/del/ins, consensus coords)?
#                  `no` means those arrive as NA and divergence-derived tracks
#                  must skip this tool rather than treat NA as zero.
#   library        Consensus library this tool used, if any. Blank = de novo /
#                  structural. Needed later for the consensus-sequence step.
#   color          itemRgb for this tool's own detail track (R,G,B).
#   priority       Tie-break rank when tools disagree and no majority exists.
#                  Lower = more trusted. NOT a quality judgement -- it only
#                  breaks exact ties, and the conflict is always reported.
#   ran            yes|no -- did this tool run on this assembly? `no` still emits
#                  an empty bigBed, because contribTracks requires identical
#                  filenames across all assembly directories.
#   notes          Free text.
tool_id
rm2
column3: RepeatModeler2 de novo library, annotated with RepeatMasker
column11: Observed on GCA_951799975.1: 2274065 hits, 449.3 Mb, 77 distinct class labels, 39% of hits labelled Unknown (RepeatClassifier could not classify the de novo family). The abstention policy is therefore load-bearing, not a corner case.

column1: edta
column11: Observed: 1394714 hits, 372.3 Mb, 37 labels. Hybrid dialect -- RepeatMasker-style names (LINE/L2, SINE/MIR) mixed with Wicker codes (DTC/DTM/DTH) and MITE/ prefixes. rm_fields=mixed: homology calls (TE_homo_*, 1389546) carry full RM fields; structural calls (TE_struc_* 3995, LTRRT_* 1173) have NA divergence -- 5172 rows, matching the NA count exactly. The GenomeArk GFF3 (v2.3.2, ingested via scripts/edtagff2bed.py) DOES emit Simple_repeat (5463 records, 6.35 Mb) -> repeat:tandem:simple; the earlier RepeatMasker-derived input did not. scope stays structural_te: those votes fall outside scope and are excluded from classification, which is correct -- EDTA is not a tandem finder. GFF3 sub-features (repeat_region/lLTR/rLTR/lTSD/rTSD) are dropped to avoid triple-counting LTR loci. See docs/EDTA.md.

column1: pantera
column3: Pantera pangenome-derived TE library, annotated with RepeatMasker
column11: Observed: 1213581 hits, 237.6 Mb, 21 labels, zero NA. Coarsest vocabulary of the three: 40% bare DNA and 29% Unknown, so it contributes strongly to existence calls and weakly to classification.

column1: fastltr
column11: Observed on GCA_951799975.1 (GenomeArk FastLTR-RepeatMasker/GCA_951799975.1.fa.mod.out): 16772 hits, 10.71 Mb, 5 labels, all LTR/* -- confirms ltr_only scope. This is a RepeatMasker re-annotation using the fastLTR library, so perc_div IS consensus divergence (rm_fields=yes), unlike the structural-only output. Sequence names were shortened by EDTA's .fa.mod to _J000000N with no mapping published; recovered by sequence length via scripts/infer_rm_rename.py (120/126 unique). 6 scaffolds share sizes with other unplaced scaffolds and are unresolvable -- 7 hits / 7629 bp dropped. See docs/FASTLTR.md.

column1: fastan
column3: FasTAN tandem array detection (Myers), period and unit-identity estimates
column11: Observed on GCA_951799975.1: 217563 arrays, 96.3 Mb, no header, 5 native columns. TANDEM SCOPE ONLY -- contributes to existence and to tandem-class calls, and is excluded from the denominator at TE loci. Emits the single label `tandem` by default: FasTAN detects arrays but does not classify them as satellite vs simple, so scripts/fastan2bed.py abstains rather than inferring a subclass from period (--classify-period opts in). rm_fields=divergence_only: perc_div is present but is UNIT-TO-UNIT divergence within the array (array homogeneity), NOT divergence from a library consensus (age proxy) -- do not read the two as the same quantity.

column1: ltrdenovo
column3: LTRDeNovo (NGSEP) structural and homology LTR retrotransposon detection
column11: Observed on GCA_951799975.1 (native NGSEP GFF3): 3104 repeat_region elements, 7.07 Mb, 4 labels, all LTR/* -- confirms ltr_only scope. 2876 homology + 228 structural calls. GFF3 carries no score, phase, identity or divergence attribute of any kind (cols 6 and 8 are "." throughout), so rm_fields=no and it contributes to existence and classification only. Classification uses Wicker codes (RLG/RLC/RLR) under an LTR/ prefix; the four LTR Wicker rules in class_map.tsv were widened from tool=edta to tool=* to cover this. Converted from repeat_region (full LTR-to-LTR footprint), NOT transposable_element (internal domain only) -- see docs/LTRDENOVO.md.

column1: satellome
column11: Observed on GCA_951799975.1 (native BED5, 10kb-filtered file): 573 arrays >=10005 bp, 18.80 Mb, 168 families (fGobNig<serial>A), all emitted as Satellite -> repeat:tandem:satellite. The upstream file keeps only arrays >=10 kb, so absence of a call does not mean absence of satellite; shorter arrays were filtered before delivery. No score or divergence of any kind in the native output (col5 is redundantly chromEnd-chromStart, verified). Converted by scripts/satellome2bed.py; strand ".". See docs/SATELLOME.md.

column1: trf
column3: Tandem Repeats Finder (UCSC GenArk simpleRepeat track)
column11: Observed on GCA_951799975.1 via GenArk simpleRepeat.bb: 494,440 arrays, 166.6 Mb summed span, periods 1 bp to multi-kb (88% period>6). All rows emit `tandem` -> repeat:tandem; period/copyNum reach the mouseover via name p<period>_x<copies>_<unit>. perc_div = 100-perMatch is unit-to-unit array identity, NOT consensus divergence. Base composition/entropy/unit sequence not carried -- rederivable from the public GenArk track. Converted by scripts/simplerepeat2bed.py.

column1: windowmasker
column3: WindowMasker + SDust over-represented k-mer and low-complexity masking (UCSC GenArk)
column11: Observed on GCA_951799975.1 via GenArk windowMasker.bb: 4,359,169 intervals, 352.2 Mb. bigBed 3: bare intervals, no score/class of any kind; WM and SDust intervals are not distinguishable in the track. Every row emits Unknown -> bare repeat: full existence support, abstains from all classification votes -- a pure detector. Evidence is k-mer statistics, neither homology nor structure. Converted by scripts/windowmasker2bed.py.
